$comment: Third-party material that src/lib/export-document.ts copies into every exported HTML document (REQ-LTTCE-FOS-00005). Each entry names the installed npm package by its package-lock.json key, so the version is the one the export really imports. 'foss.mjs notices' renders their notices into src/lib/export-notices.generated.txt; a key that matches no shipped npm package fails the run, and a unit test fails when export-document.ts imports material from a package not listed here.
